theorems.name: Submission.gwe_vgt_graph_measurability
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (R : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (closedBall 0 R) → (∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ closedBall 0 R → MeasurableSet (q '' graphOver f A)) ∧ (∃ Fh : Rn n → Amb n ℓ, Measurable Fh ∧ ∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) R, Fh x = q (graphPoint x (f x))) ∧ Measurable (fun x : Rn n => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
